text:
alina: Quick sync 305 - EdgeWorks SI wants a tidy evidence bundle to finish marketplace QA. They asked for: SOC2 summary, latest external pen-test PDF, vuln-scan CSVs, questionnaire answers, and a short controls->evidence mapping. They want upload presigns by Mon EOD.

sam: Thanks. Do we have an assigned owner for each artifact type? Last time the ownership was fuzzy.

maria: I can own the mapping doc and the scope.md. I'll pull SOC2 artifacts from GCS and annotate which tests map to which control.

ben: I'll own the pen-test redaction pass. Note: the external report includes internal hostnames/IPs and two stack traces. Need legal check on disclosure. @legal can you confirm permissibility?

legal: We reviewed the SLA and NDA. Sharing redacted reports with SI partners is allowed. Please remove raw logs and internal IPs; keep high-level findings and remediation notes. Include a one-line attestation in the manifest.

jack: I'll provision a temp S3 bucket and generate presigned POSTs. Proposed policy: presign validity 72h, temp bucket lifecycle 21 days, copy to rw-compliance-archive (365d retention) after ingest. Anyone object?

alina: Sound good. EdgeWorks asked for a simple upload flow for their vendor team. Can we provide a bash + curl example and a small Node script?

jack: Yep. Example presign command I'll hand off:
```bash
aws s3api create-presigned-post --bucket rw-evidence-edgeworks-temp --key "{artifact_type}/${filename}" --expires-in 259200
```
And sample curl: `curl -X POST -F "file=@pen-redacted.pdf" <presigned-url>`

maria: For manifests, I'm proposing newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) with fields: filename, type, owner, redacted, source_link, sha256, notes. Easier for reviewers to parse.

sam: Good. For the vendor questionnaire answers, I'll run the last saved copy and mark changes. We'll attach a versioned PDF and a one-page summary.

security-bot: Automated scan: pen-test pdf `reports/pen-2026-02.pdf` flagged internal IPs at pages 8-9 and stack traces on page 21. Vulnerability CSVs sanitized? status: partial.

ben: I'll redact the flagged areas, regenerate PDF, and produce a redaction log (CSV) listing byte offsets and rationale. Will also add a small `redaction_notice.txt` inside the ZIP per legal guidance.

legal: Please ensure the redaction notice includes the statement: "Certain internal identifiers removed per internal policy and NDA; contact compliance+marketplace@redwood.ai for questions."

alina: Good. Also need a control mapping file `controls_map.md` for the marketplace reviewers: table of control -> evidence file + owner + short test description. Maria will own.

maria: I'll drop the draft to GH under compliance/edgeworks/<timestamp> and ping here.

jack: CI will generate presigns and post a single tarball instruction. I'll add a tiny CI job `ci-bot` to create the presigns and set `x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms` on the archive copy.

ci-bot: Job queued: `presign-edgeworks-2211112222`. Will run when artifacts are uploaded to the temp bucket.

sam: EdgeWorks also wants contact for follow-ups and a one-paragraph product description for listing. I'll provide `compliance+marketplace@redwood.ai` and product blurb.

ben: Timeline: redaction + evidence signoff Tue, mapping + scope Wed, presigns + upload instructions Thu, share links Fri morning. Any blockers?

alina: If legal needs to re-review redactions, tag me immediately. Also coordinate with Partnerships PM (cc: sam) before we share for any marketing-sensitive items.

security-bot: Event recorded: marketplace-evidence-handoff-2211112222. Access TTL configured: presign window 72h; temp bucket lifecycle 21d; archive retention 365d.

maria: I'll include `scope_and_summary.md`, `controls_map.md`, `redaction_notice.txt`, `ndjson_manifest.ndjson`, and `attestations.txt` inside each artifact ZIP.

jack: I'll upload scripts to repo: `infra/compliance/presign-scripts/edgeworks/`. Will include both bash and node examples.

sam: I'll assemble the questionnaire and add it to the NDJSON manifest as `type: questionnaire`.

alina: Perfect. Thanks all 40. We'll reconvene here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
